Leech is a game mechanic that regenerates the Health of a character based on the damage that they've dealt. Leech will not heal a player for any overkill damage (damage that is dealt that is higher than the remaining health of the mob).

Leech instances are independent and have a fixed duration of three seconds. All leech instances are removed when you reach full health.
